title: Angle α value
description: Essential: The answer must state α = 30°.

title: Potential difference U
description: Essential: The answer must state U = 3mv₀²/(2q).

title: X-coordinate of N
description: Essential: The answer must state x_N = (3√3/4)v₀T.

title: Boundary equation
description: Important: The answer must provide the correct linear equation for the boundary, relating y and x.

title: Magnetic field B₁
description: Essential: The answer must state B₁ = √3 m/(6qT).

title: Time for n-th passage
description: Essential: The answer must provide the correct expression for t_n, including the geometric series term.

title: Velocity decomposition reasoning
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve the final velocity at N into components parallel and perpendicular to the electric field.

title: Kinematics in electric field
description: Important: The solution must apply constant acceleration kinematics to find the displacement and time of flight in the E-field.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: The solution must use the work-energy theorem to relate the potential difference to the change in kinetic energy.

title: Circular motion geometry
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must correctly analyze the geometry of the circular arcs in the decaying magnetic field.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize incorrect sign for the slope of the boundary or misassignment of velocity vector directions.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Penalize if final answers are presented with inconsistent or missing units where required.
